section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single study, approved by a university IRB, where participants received research credit. The study involved two parts: participants completed a 60-minute web-based survey (Part One), and then their confidants completed paper questionnaires, including a measure of gratitude based on their perception of the participant (Part Two). The section highlights an exceptional compliance rate, with 137 out of 140 packets returned, attributed to researcher emphasis, email prompts, and credit incentives.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire section '2.2. Procedure' describes the methodology and participant engagement for the study.
